title: Mixed Event — Secret Operation Valentine's Day — Episode7 Everyone's Assigned Duties

meta.Event Outline: With Valentine's Day just on the horizon, Airi is planning a surprise for everyone to show them her gratitude. She happens to meet Saki and Emu, who both had similar ideas, and they form a Secret Valentine's Day Alliance.

rows.Line: Valentine's Day
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Drum rooolll... Ta-daa!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, Nene, Rui!
Happy Valentine's Day!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Is this?!
A chocolate cake?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I had a feeling that you were up to something, Emu, but I wasn't expecting anything like this... I mean, you made this cake, right...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
This is incredible!
Look at all the plushies that are lined up together!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, they appear to be macarons.
It must've taken quite a bit of effort to create such a masterpiece of a cake.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I still can't believe it...!
Where did you find the time to bake this?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe! I worked really, really hard to make sure all of you were super duper surprised!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It's magnificent.
The effort you put into it certainly seems to have paid off, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: It looks so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It really is incredible. I've never seen such a wonderful cake before... I must be dreaming...♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Or...
Am I already dreaming...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, Luka, this isn't a dream!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, this is the fruit of Emu's hard labor. She baked this for all of us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's like a tent full of wonderful dreams, but it's a cake☆ What kind of show do you think they're doing?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
L-Luka?!
How can you fall asleep at a time like this?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe! Were you all surprised?
Do you feel really wonderhoy?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
Fantastically won-won-wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I agree. Thank you so much for baking this for us, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'd like to thank you as well.
And you did a wonderful job.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heh heh heh heh...♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That means my Valentine's Day surprise was a great, big success...!!
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Shiho, aren't these the chocolates you can only get at PXL?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
They all look like Phenny too!
That's adorable!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I know, right? These are only available this year, but I usually get whatever they release each year since the boxes they come in are so cute.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Honami, Ichika, did you two get the same chocolates...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
As it happens, yes.
I ran into Ichika at the mall while I was shopping around for chocolates...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we decided to go for something a little more extravagant together this year.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see.
Hehe. You two are so close.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What did you get, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
Happy Valentine's Day, everyone!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
This cake's huge...!
And these cookies on top... That's us, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! I even have cookies for Miku and everyone else♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa, it’s me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You had these specially made? That must've been expensive...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nope. I made them!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Honami
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
They're homemade?
Th-These are unbelievable...!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't know you could make cute cookies like this, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I worked really hard to make sure you'd all be surprised♪ Also, they turned out nicely because of Airi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: An in Momoi...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hold on...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki...
Does this mean you were baking these when...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Um... Teehee...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So that's why you were keeping it a secret.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. Sorry about making you worry like that, but I really wanted to surprise you guys somehow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, Saki.
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy Valentine's Day!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh wow! Haruka's chocolates are so cute! They're little penguins!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I like the hearts you made, Minori.
Oh, they even have our names written in chocolate.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And the decorations you put on them are really adorable.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad you like them♪
Your chocolates also look really yummy, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, they even come with a little card.
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
A-Airi, wait!
They're not meant to be read out loud!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, okay.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, it's my turn next.
Mind coming over to SEKAI with me for a second...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: To SEKAI?
